Excluded overall: author lines, dates, next/previous article links, the 'The Go Blog' index link/heading, 'Blog Index', site navigation, footer. Changed since 2026-11-07: a new post 'Go Turns 17' (10 November 2026) now heads the index, so the three visited posts are 17years, jsonv2 and emudhra-incident; 'Help set Go's priorities for next year' dropped out, and 'Generic Methods' fell off the bottom of the index. jsonv2 now has a 'Next article: Go Turns 17' link.
